scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run check && npm test
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && git push --follow-tags && npm publish && gh release create "$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)" --generate-notes
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push --follow-tags && npm publish && gh release create "$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)" --generate-notes
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push --follow-tags && npm publish && gh release create "$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)" --generate-notes
